entries.raw: Our systematic analysis covers 29 papers selected through structured search across academic databases and industry research. Selection criteria prioritized: • Theoretical Relevance: Papers addressing commoditization, platform competition, or technology product lifecycles • Empirical Quality: Academic papers with substantial citation impact or industry research with methodological rigor • Temporal Coverage: 15-year span (2010-2025) capturing both historical patterns and contemporary developments • Source Diversity: Balanced representation of economics, business strategy, and technology management perspectives
